title: AuditEntry
description: One row of the append-only, tamper-evident chain. entryHash is SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical JSON of every other member (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Canonicalization and hashing'). previousHash is inside the hashed body: hashing without it would let a predecessor be rewritten undetected. Verify from persisted rows, never from an in-process copy.

sequence.description: Contiguous from 1 per project. A gap is a deletion.

action.description: dotted lowercase, e.g. match.verified, match.rejected, actual.corrected.

payload.description: Action-specific canonical JSON. Must not contain credentials or raw attachment bytes.

previousHash.description: entryHash of sequence-1, or 64 zeros at sequence 1.
